Quality does not match the price
Sep 2026 • Family
I came to the restaurant based on the Google recommendation. I'm not sure if the high ratings are based on actual customer experience, but this was my first and last time at the place. The food is ordinary compared to the quite high price, the service was the most disappointing, constantly slow and making mistakes. The beef was told to cook thoroughly, but it's medium rare again after waiting too long. Although the staff continuously apologized for the late delivery, having to wait too long made me very uncomfortable.

Wonderful Sushi
Sep 2026 • Solo
My 1st time in Hanoi and thus at Sushi Ichi. I had the octopus appetizer and the taco wasabi appetizer. Next the 5 sashimi selection served with dry ice, looking pretty cool. To top it off Wagyu with tofu and Herring sashimi. Last but not least 2 mochi ice cream. Everything was fantastic and service was very friendly and speedy. Definitely my favorite sushi in Hanoi this far. Side note: I took a video of the dry ice but video not supported here 🥴

Best service in Hanoi so far
Aug 2026 • Family
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Very impressive service and food! This was the best service we’ve experienced so far in Hanoi, even compared with the 5-star international hotels we’ve stayed at.

We first went to SUSHU ICHI 2, but they were fully booked. Instead of keeping us waiting, the team arranged a table for us at this branch, booked a Grab for our convenience, and even had a staff member waiting at the door to welcome us.

The food was incredibly fresh and professionally prepared, and the staff were so attentive throughout the meal.
So 2 days later, we visited again
